newsitem.title: USA: CD Warehouse gets $1.0 mln in financing.
newsitem.headline: CD Warehouse gets $1.0 mln in financing.

text.p: CD Warehouse Inc said it entered into an agreement with Berthel, Fisher & Co Leasing Inc to provide up to $1 million in equipment financing to franchisees.

In a statement issued Tuesday, CD Warehouse said the agreement provides that Berthel, Fisher will finance up to $40,000 per store of equipment costs, for an aggregate financing commitment of $1 million.
CD Warehouse stores buys and sells compact discs. As of March 1, there were 112 franchised CD Warehouse stores in 25 states and England.
